display.purpose: Page titles and panel headers. The ceiling of the type scale — no marketing-scale heading exists above it.

body.purpose: Default paragraph and UI text throughout the dashboard.

shadows.name: floating-sm
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns and small popovers — content that floats above the page.

motion.name: ease-control
motion.purpose: Default transition for buttons, inputs, and other interactive controls (background/filter/outline changes).

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Onboarding and celebratory reveal moments (rare — most of the UI is not choreographed).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid, saturated control in the system — primary actions only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:0 16px; background:#008069; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:8px; font-family:Inter,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:460; line-height:21px; letter-spacing:-0.28px; cursor:pointer; transition:filter 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #008069; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Faded Button
components.description: The default secondary action — brand color at low opacity, more common in this system than a bordered outline button.
components.css: .ds-btn-faded { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:40px; padding:0 16px; background:rgba(0,128,105,0.1); color:#008069; border:none; border-radius:8px; font-family:Inter,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:460; line-height:21px; letter-spacing:-0.28px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-faded:hover { background:rgba(0,128,105,0.2); } .ds-btn-faded:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #008069; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Every decision in this system is tested against one question: would this feel native inside WhatsApp Web? This is a Chatwoot fork built for a commercial support team, and the entire reskin exists to erase the feeling of "enterprise support software." The base app stays untouched in structure; what changes is surface: a green accent lifted directly from WhatsApp's own palette, a tan-speckled chat wallpaper behind every conversation, rounded message bubbles with a WhatsApp-shaped tail corner, and delivery ticks that match WhatsApp's own gray-single / gray-double / blue-double-read sequence exactly. This is explicitly not a marketing surface — it's a product register, and the system optimizes for density, clarity of state, and fast repeated actions over visual flourish.
keyCharacteristics: Green (#008069) as the single brand accent, reserved for primary actions and the outgoing-message state.
A warm, textured wallpaper (#E5DDD5) behind every message thread — the one deliberately decorative surface in an otherwise restrained system.
Flat, bordered surfaces at rest; shadow appears only when something floats above the page.
A tight numeric weight scale (420/440/460/520/620) instead of the usual 400/500/600 jumps.
No hero sections, no marketing scale-up — the largest heading is a page title, not a headline.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: WhatsApp Green is the only saturated color used for interactive intent. Everything else is either semantic (status) or purely atmospheric (wallpaper).

rules.name: The No-Display Rule
rules.body: This is a product register: there is no marketing-scale display type anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Grounded Rule
rules.body: If an element is part of the page's normal flow, it does not get a shadow. Shadow signals content has left the document flow to float above it.

dos: Do use #008069 (WhatsApp Green) as the only saturated accent for interactive intent — buttons, links, active nav state.
Do keep outgoing bubbles at #D9FDD3 and incoming bubbles neutral gray/white — the color is the direction cue.
Do use a 1px Border Hairline (#EAEAEA) or outline to define any surface at rest.
Do reserve shadow (shadow-md / shadow-lg) exclusively for content floating above the page — dropdowns, modals, popovers, tooltips.
Do use rounded-2xl (16px) specifically for message bubbles and rounded-lg (8px) for controls/panels.
Do ship every new UI string in pt_BR alongside en in the same commit.
donts: Don't build toward the stock Chatwoot look (neutral blue, denser enterprise chrome) — that is this fork's explicit anti-reference.
Don't add shadow to anything sitting in normal page flow — cards, list rows, message bubbles.
Don't introduce a marketing-scale display heading (32px+) anywhere in this dashboard.
Don't over-build empty states or configuration screens for genuinely small entities.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.
Don't use gradient text anywhere — a single solid ink or brand color, with weight/size for emphasis.
